content: अशन [अश्-ल्युट्] {%a.%} Reaching, reaching across. .{@-नः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a tree = असन <ab>q. v.</ab> (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>आसणा</ns>). .{@-नम्@} .²1 Pervasion, penetration. .²2 The act of eating, feeding. .²3 Tasting, enjoying. .²4 Food; अशनं धात्रा मरुत्कल्पितं व्यालानाम् <ls>Bh. 3. 10</ls>; भांसाशनं च नाश्नीयुः <ls>Ms. 5. 73</ls>; यज्ञशिष्ट˚ <ls n="Ms.">3. 118</ls>; फलमूलाशनैः <ls n="Ms.">5. 54</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> at the end of adjective <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘eating’, ‘one whose food is’ <ab>&c.</ab>; फलमूलाशन, हुताशन, पवनाशन <ab>&c.</ab>
